plain: A researcher named Greg, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, describes a tape recording of Andrija Puharich, a scientist the episode connects to the CIA, the US intelligence agency. According to Greg, on the tape Puharich says jokingly that he is a double agent, in connection with Israel. If there was truth behind the joke, it would mean he was secretly serving more than one country.
